about: The shape and progress of segments (docs/scene-state-v2.md "補間", ADR 0064). Each case: `state` is read with load_scene_state / loadSceneState and evaluated at each of `frames` with the output length `length`; `expected` is the evaluation, which Python and JS give within 1e-4.

cases.name: circle_linear
cases.about: Four keys on a circle, Linear: an arc at one speed whatever the time between keys.

cases.name: smooth_uneven
cases.about: Smooth through uneven keys: slow out of the first, passing the middle ones, slow into the last.

cases.name: corner
cases.about: A corner key in the middle: two straight segments, and the speed does not stop there.

cases.name: handles
cases.about: A handle on one side of a passing key turns the other side opposite; both handles at an end bend it.

cases.name: cubic_neighbors
cases.about: Ease in, Smooth, ease out: the Smooth segment joins the speeds of its cubic-bezier neighbors.

cases.name: turn_back_and_stationary
cases.about: A key the path turns straight back at stops; a segment that does not move holds still.

cases.name: hold_border
cases.about: A hold cuts; the keys at its ends do not pass and start and stop.

cases.name: rotation_direction_scalars
cases.about: Rotation, a sky direction, roll, size and opacity under Smooth and Linear.

cases.name: rotation_keys_evenly_timed
cases.about: The same rotation keys at other times: the shape does not depend on the times (docs/scene-state-v2.md "形（回転・direction）"); the two cases pass the same orientations.

cases.name: rotation_keys_unevenly_timed
cases.about: The same rotation keys at other times: the shape does not depend on the times (docs/scene-state-v2.md "形（回転・direction）"); the two cases pass the same orientations.
